verdict.rationale: Box documents read-only shared links for folders with configurable access levels, role-based collaborations for users and groups, and expiring embedded previews. A community user confirms it can selectively grant outside parties access to folders. Access visibility exists only as developer tooling (event feed, download webhooks), and the evidence never shows a control to disable or restrict downloads. Missing for 10: explicit download-restriction controls, a built-in access/activity report for data-room viewers (rather than API events), and hands-on corroboration of a diligence data-room workflow.
